title: GREAC code v1.0.1: production scripts of the Global Reservoir Elevation–Area–Capacity dataset
description: Code that produced GREAC v1.0, a global dataset of elevation–area–capacity curves and 30 m bathymetry for 28,481 reservoirs derived from digital elevation models (FABDEM, NASADEM) and the Landsat surface-water record: regions and water levels, topographic-continuity reconstruction with the dam-height depth scale, SRTM-recorded floors, small-reservoir tier, indicators and the data package, as they were run. See README.md for the workflow and the input data. Version 1.0.1 adds the attribute flag_empty_extent (seven reservoirs with an empty maximum extent and no bed raster) to the data package.
